error.FORBIDDEN: You are not able to request access to this listing.

pending.title: Your request is with the seller
pending.body: Submitted on {date}. You will be notified as soon as the seller decides.

closed.title: Confidential

listingForm.newSubtitle: The public teaser below is visible to every visitor. The confidential section only reaches a buyer once you approve their access request.
listingForm.editSubtitle: Update the public teaser and the confidential details behind it.
listingForm.rejectionNotice: A platform manager rejected this listing: {reason}

sections.teaserBody: Visible to every visitor, signed in or not.
sections.confidentialBody: Released only to a buyer once you approve their access request for this listing.

fields.teaserDescriptionHint: 40-2000 characters. Do not name the company or give exact figures — the confidentiality check below can help.
fields.includedPlaceholder: e.g. Licence, client book, core team
fields.includedHint: Up to 8 short highlights shown on the teaser card.

listingForm.submittedNotice: Submitted for review. A platform manager will decide whether to publish it.
listingForm.unpublishedForReviewNotice: Your changes were saved, but this listing is no longer publicly visible: editing a published listing sends it back for review. A platform manager will decide whether to publish it again.

review.unavailable: The check could not run right now. You can still submit the listing.
review.advisory: This check is advisory: you may submit the listing regardless of what it finds.
